name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Commercial Four-Wheeler Vehicles
benefit: - Subsidy under the scheme is provided at the rate of 25% of the actual cost of the four-wheeler (₹9 lakh) or ₹2.25 lakh, whichever is lower.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
